rows.name: Real browser login sets an HttpOnly cookie and authorizes the owner
Expired access renews through the real route without remounting or losing an unsaved owner form
Two tabs renew concurrently and remain authorized without discarding the owner draft
Refresh receipts remain valid across an actual application restart
Mobile sign-out retries a failure, then revokes only that server session and clears its cookie
Password reset revokes every owner device, preserves another tenant, and keeps the reset success message visible
The real application rejects an untrusted origin without logging the owner out
The eight-hour absolute session limit requires sign-in again instead of extending indefinitely
No browser runtime errors, access tokens or refresh secrets appear in application logs
Signup survives failed provider delivery, exposes retry and preserves pending_payment
Resend gives an absolute link; opening it hides the fragment and requires explicit verification
Signed-in account screen shows verified state
Reused verification link is rejected and recovery request stays private for verified accounts
Sign-in exposes password recovery; known and unknown requests show the same response
Durable reset works after server restart; confirmation mismatch stays on the form; successful reset clears the browser session
Old password fails, new password signs in and existing signup/billing flow preserves pending_payment
Reused reset fails and preserves entered form values
Malformed links offer recovery on mobile without horizontal overflow
No browser runtime errors or account link tokens in application logs
